item_title: Land use item deferred at the City Attorney's request
document_text: Action: Upon motion by Vice Mayor Pam Foley, seconded by Councilmember Domingo Candelas, and carried unanimously, Item 10.1(a) was deferred, per the City Attorney's Office request. (11-0-0)

motions.text: Item 10.1(a) was deferred, per the City Attorney's Office request
